title: Debbie Smith Reauthorization Act of 2014
official_summary:
(This measure has not been amended since it was introduced. The summary of that version is repeated here.)

Debbie Smith Reauthorization Act of 2014 - Amends the Debbie Smith Act of 2004 to reauthorize funding through FY2019 for: (1) the Debbie Smith DNA Backlog Grant Program; (2) DNA training and education for law enforcement, correctional personnel, and court officers; and (3) sexual assault forensic exam program grants.

summary.headline: This law extends federal funding through fiscal year 2019 for DNA backlog grants, DNA training for justice personnel, and sexual assault forensic exam programs.
summary.what_it_does: It amends the Debbie Smith Act of 2004 to keep three federal grant programs funded through fiscal year 2019. The programs cover reducing DNA evidence backlogs, training law enforcement, correctional staff, and court officers in DNA use, and paying for sexual assault forensic exam programs. The summary does not list dollar amounts.

who_it_affects.how: They can receive federal grants to reduce backlogs of DNA evidence awaiting analysis.

who_it_affects.group: Law enforcement, correctional personnel, and court officers
who_it_affects.how: They can receive federally funded DNA training and education.
Forensic exam programs that receive these grants may be funded to provide sexual assault examinations.

who_it_affects.group: Hospitals and programs that run sexual assault forensic exams
who_it_affects.how: They can apply for federal grant funding to support these exam programs through fiscal year 2019.

summary.when_it_takes_effect: Took effect on enactment on September 29, 2014, with funding authorized through fiscal year 2019.
